name: Baldric of the Prepared Mind
body:
Aura faint evocation; CL 3rd; Slot chest; Price 3,600 gp (lesser), 10,800 gp (standard), 18,000 gp (greater); Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This belt is worn over one shoulder and across the chest, it is typically used to carry a weapon (usually a sword) this one’s appearance seems to change to suit the wearer’s will. At the beginning of your turn, you may as a free action gain the benefit of one the following feats: Quick Draw, Improved Dirty Trick, or Equipment Trick; with any weapon that had been previously secured by the baldric within the last 24 hours. You do not need to meet the prerequisites of the feat to gain its benefits. You gain the benefit of that feat until the beginning of your next turn. A lesser baldric can be used 1/day, a standard baldric can be used 3/day, and a greater baldric can be used 5/day. A luckbringer can activate this ability one additional time per day by expending a moment of chance.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells heroic fortune; Cost 1,800 gp (lesser), 5,400 gp (standard), 6,000 gp (greater)
